text: NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN THAT a Real Property Acquisition and Disposition Public Hearing, in accordance with Section 1301(2)(g) of the New York City Charter, will be held on Tuesday, December 28, 2021, commencing at 10:00 AM via Conference Call. Call-in #[CALL_IN_NUMBER], Access Code [ACCESS_CODE], in the matter of a proposed amendment of lease as submitted by the New York City Economic Development Corporation (NYCEDC) on behalf of the City of New York acting through its Department of Small Business Services, as Landlord, to South Street Seaport Limited Partnership, 199 Water Street, New York, New York, as Tenant, of various city-owned properties. A draft copy of the proposed amendment of Lease will be available for inspection at New York City Economic Development Corporation, One Liberty Plaza, New York, New York 10006, commencing November 26, 2021 through December 28, 2021, exclusive of Saturdays, Sundays and Holidays, between the hours of 10:00 a.m. and 2:00 p.m. To schedule an inspection, please contact Orion Hinkley at [INSPECTION_PHONE]. If you need further accommodations, please let us know at least 5 business days in advance of the Public Hearing via email, at [ACCOMMODATION_EMAIL], or via phone at [ACCOMMODATION_PHONE].
